_note: Authored 2026-08-21 from the pilot's own v4 category table, so the seeded simulator prices the SAME eleven groups the brief computed by hand — the group sizes are the brief's redundancy claims and the audit prices them hypergeometrically. What the model does NOT see, and why every rate here is a FLOOR for this deck in particular: Kianne's parity flash (the whole design is casting on other players' turns), the +1/+1 counter per card drawn, counter multipliers, and Utopia Sprawl's aura ramp. model_combat is deliberately OFF. It was tried and the output rejected: goldfish.py has no model of 'Whenever you draw' triggers or +1/+1 counters (grep confirms zero), so it scored Kianne at her printed 2/2 forever and reported mean board power 4.2 at turn 6 across ~2 bodies — printed power, on a deck whose entire damage comes from a growing commander it cannot see. It also swings at one opponent who never blocks and keeps no separate commander-damage total, which is the actual win condition. A clock that confidently measures the wrong quantity is worse than no clock.
